_about: Hand-set playbook for the prospecting engine (scripts/hq/prospects.py → hq/prospect-targets.json → IMN HQ 'Where to prospect'). One entry per brand: who to approach (segments), what we offer them, where (regions), and how much each segment is worth (weight 0-1). Organisations only, published addresses only, ≤10 emails a week per brand (claude/OUTREACH.md). Edit weights or set active:false to steer the engine.

segments.label: Visitor information centre / tourism association
segments.offer: The free {region} day trip plan and town guide for their visitors' page.
segments.evidence: A 'plan your visit' or 'useful links' page that already links to outside guides.

segments.label: Traders' group / chamber of commerce
segments.offer: A free guide that sends day-trippers to {region}'s main street, to share with members or link from their site.
segments.evidence: A members or 'visit our town' page with outside links.

segments.label: Council tourism / events page
segments.offer: The {region} guide as a free resource on their visitor or events page.
segments.evidence: A council 'visiting {region}' page listing resources.

segments.label: Historical society / museum
segments.offer: Their museum featured in the {region} guide; a link back from their 'getting here' page.
segments.evidence: A 'getting here' or 'local attractions' page.

segments.label: Workforce Australia provider
segments.offer: Free resume builder, cover letter builder and job finder their participants can use today.
segments.evidence: A 'job seeker resources' page with outside tools.
search: employment services provider {region} job seeker resources

segments.label: Disability employment / Inclusive Employment Australia provider
segments.offer: Free, plain-language resume and job tools, plus 1:1 mentoring for participants who want weekly support.
segments.evidence: A participant resources page.

segments.label: Neighbourhood house / community centre
segments.offer: Free job tools for their computer and job-help sessions.
segments.evidence: A 'useful links' or job-help program page.

segments.label: Public library (job help / digital literacy)
segments.offer: Free resume and cover letter builders for their job-seeker resources list.
segments.evidence: A library 'job seekers' or 'careers' resources page.

segments.label: TAFE Skills and Jobs Centre
segments.offer: Free job tools to list alongside their career advice.
segments.evidence: A careers or job-ready resources page.

segments.label: NDIS support coordinator / plan manager
segments.offer: 1:1 goal mentoring with weekly written notes, for participants with capacity-building funding.
segments.evidence: A provider directory or 'our partners' page.

segments.label: Trade association member resources
segments.offer: A free {region} invoice and quote template (GST done, saves as PDF) for their members' resources page.
segments.evidence: A member resources or business tools page.

segments.label: TAFE apprentice / trade course page
segments.offer: A free invoice template for apprentices starting out on their own.
segments.evidence: An apprentice resources or 'starting your business' page.

segments.label: Apprenticeship Network provider
segments.offer: Free trade paperwork templates for their apprentices.
segments.evidence: An apprentice resources page.

segments.label: Film society / classic film club
segments.offer: Free trailers and where-to-watch for every classic film on their screening list.
segments.evidence: A links or 'resources' page.

segments.label: Film school / university film club
segments.offer: The Original films pitch page for students' short films.
segments.evidence: A student resources page.

segments.label: Independent / repertory cinema
segments.offer: Trailer pages for their classic screenings.
segments.evidence: A 'classics' or repertory program page.

segments.label: Library film program
segments.offer: Trailers and where-to-watch for their film-club titles.
segments.evidence: A film club or movie night page.

segments.label: University / TAFE careers service
segments.offer: A free take-home pay calculator for students comparing job offers.
segments.evidence: A careers resources page with outside tools.

segments.label: Migrant / multicultural resource centre
segments.offer: A plain-language pay calculator showing tax and super for new workers.
segments.evidence: An employment resources page.

segments.label: Youth employment service
segments.offer: A free pay calculator for young people's first job.
segments.evidence: A youth job resources page.

segments.label: Financial counselling / money support service
segments.offer: A free pay and tax calculator for budgeting sessions.
segments.evidence: A useful tools page.
